title: ai-sdlc project configuration (sdlc.config.json)
description: Written by /ai-sdlc:sdlc-init and read by every hook, adapter and command of the ai-sdlc plugin. The plugin's scripts/config/validate.sh checks a file against this schema with jq alone.

pluginVersion.description: ai-sdlc version that last rendered this repository; /sdlc-upgrade compares against it.

platform.description: Where work items and pull requests live. 'none' keeps artifacts local.

tier.description: 0 foundation, 1 artifacts, 2 review policy (branch protection, CODEOWNERS, REVIEW.md), 3 automation. Each tier requires the ones below it.

verify.description: The one command that proves the code works.

verifySetup.description: Command scripts/verify/run-isolated.sh runs inside the disposable worktree before commands.verify when the verifier uses it, for example a dependency install.

format.description: Formatter the agent runs after a coherent change and before finishing; nothing runs per edit.

lint.description: Linter the agent runs after a coherent change and before finishing; nothing runs per edit.

deployStaging.description: Shell command the generated deploy workflow runs for that environment; SDLC_ENVIRONMENT and SDLC_SHA are exported.

deployProduction.description: Shell command the generated deploy workflow runs for that environment; SDLC_ENVIRONMENT and SDLC_SHA are exported.

enablePluginForTeam.description: Write enabledPlugins into .claude/settings.json so teammates get ai-sdlc and mattpocock-skills automatically.

codeowners.description: Space-separated GitHub handles or teams that own every path (CODEOWNERS).

securityOwners.description: Space-separated handles that own the human-only areas (auth, crypto, payments).

runner.description: Where the advisory pull-request review runs. ci (default): the rendered sdlc-pr-review workflow or pipeline, which needs the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret. local: no review workflow is rendered or installed; after a PR is created the launch-local-review hook opens a terminal window running /ai-sdlc:sdlc-review with the developer's own Claude login. With local, github.requiredChecks must not name sdlc-pr-review and azure.pipelineName, when set, names a custom build requirement, never the review pipeline.

localLauncher.description: Optional command template the launch-local-review hook runs with bash -c instead of its built-in terminal detection (wt.exe, cmd start, open, x-terminal-emulator). Placeholders: {script} (launcher script path), {cwd} (project directory), {title} (window title).

localAuth.description: Environment policy for the local review session. login (default): every ANTHROPIC_* variable and the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN / CLAUDE_CODE_USE_* provider switches are removed so the session falls back to the /login credentials. inherit: authentication and provider variables are kept. Session-state variables of the launching session are always removed.

alertThresholdUsd.description: Weekly spend above which the cost report raises an alert.

requireTicket.description: Deprecated: accepted for compatibility, enforced by nothing (the ticket gate hook was removed); safe to delete.

protectedPaths.description: Globs the agent may not modify. Nothing by default; <artifacts>/UNLOCK_PROTECTED and <artifacts>/release/** are always protected. Absent and [] both mean no extra entries.

secretPaths.description: Globs the guard-secrets hook treats as secret material. Absent: the plugin defaults (with the .env.example exemption); []: only the fixed home-directory credential paths; a list replaces the defaults and is applied literally. Configures the hook only; the deny rules in .claude/settings.json are separate (see docs/SECURITY.md).

testGlobs.description: Deprecated: accepted for compatibility, enforced by nothing (the test-freeze hook was removed); safe to delete.

ticketFreePaths.description: Deprecated: accepted for compatibility, enforced by nothing (the ticket gate hook was removed); safe to delete.

verifyExtensions.description: Deprecated: accepted for compatibility, enforced by nothing (the per-edit format/lint hook was removed); safe to delete.

dir.description: Where specs, tickets, verification reports, releases, postmortems and metrics accumulate. Default .sdlc

deployCommandPatterns.description: Shell command globs that gate-production.sh treats as production-affecting. No built-in defaults: absent or [] gates nothing. Only environments.prod is read by the hook.
